source_note: Verified Geography Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary, FR. FRANK MONORUAC). 80 lesson plans covering the internal and external structure of the Earth, map and photograph reading, and human geography (agriculture, water management, forestry, mining, tourism, manufacturing, transport, settlements, population, trade, environment), plus comprehensive review lessons. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.

lessons.title: GEOGRAPHY FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 1: THE INTERNAL STRUCTURE OF THE EARTH
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the Earth's internal structure and landform processes
lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Describe the layers of the Earth's interior and their characteristics
lessons.main_activity: Explain the concept of the internal structure of the Earth
lessons.specific_activity: Describe the Crust, Mantle, and Core
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Hard-boiled egg model demonstration, globe, wall chart of Earth interior, TIE Form 2 Geography Textbook, pp. 1â€“12.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Geography for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 2, pp. 1â€“12. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Uses a hard-boiled egg to draw attention to layered structures; asks learners what the shell, white and yolk represent.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Observe the cut egg and relate its layers to the Earth's interior.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners connect the egg analogy to the idea of layered Earth structure.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains the Crust, Mantle and Core using the wall chart and globe, highlighting composition, thickness and temperature.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes on the three layers and their distinguishing characteristics.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners describe the main features of the Crust, Mantle and Core.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides learners to draw and label a cross-section of the Earth's interior.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Draw and label the Earth's internal layers with their key features.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners produce correctly labelled cross-sections of the Earth.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews the labelled diagrams, consolidates the concept, and assigns homework.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present diagrams, answer oral questions, and note the homework.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners explain the internal structure of the Earth clearly.

lessons.title: GEOGRAPHY FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 2: IGNEOUS ROCKS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the Earth's internal structure and landform processes
lessons.specific_competence: 1.2 Explain the processes of rock formation and classify major rock types
lessons.main_activity: Analyze the role of Earth's internal structure in rock formation
lessons.specific_activity: Classify and describe Igneous rocks

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Displays rock specimens (basalt, granite) and asks learners where such rocks come from.

teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners recognise that rocks have natural origins.

teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Learners link new learning to igneous rocks.

lessons.title: GEOGRAPHY FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 11: WEATHERING
